name: Sandomierz County (Poland)
description: Three vertical stripes of blue, yellow and blue in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the county arms of Sandomierz: a shield with red and white bars and yellow stars on blue.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
